judgment_calls.decision: Two probable rules with identical evidence: Irreducible inguinal hernia (synonym incarcerated) and Strangulated inguinal hernia; the Urgent rule references both.
judgment_calls.alternatives: One rule diagnosing only Irreducible inguinal hernia.

judgment_calls.decision: Encoded as Cough impulse of mass present (only concept available). Standing/straining enlargement not representable.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Inguinal-canal-specific cough impulse concept; leaving criterion out.

judgment_calls.topic: No stools or flatus for past 24 hours
judgment_calls.decision: Constipation AND Unable to break wind, each with onset >= 24 hours ago.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Obstipation (disorder) alone, whose meaning (severe constipation) is not clearly 'no stools or flatus'.

judgment_calls.topic: Lump cannot be reduced / pulsating lump
judgment_calls.decision: Groin mass with Irreducible / Pulsatile qualifier.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Irreducible hernia morphologic abnormality (presupposes diagnosis); Pulsatile mass of abdomen (wrong site).

judgment_calls.decision: Lump at a site AND explicit (no …) of skin mass, thyroid moving on swallowing, cough impulse and recurrent abscess.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Site lump alone (fires more often); not-active_condition of the other diagnoses.

judgment_calls.decision: Possible Monkeypox gated on probable lymphadenopathy, exposure to monkeypox virus, rash/lesion at listed sites, and >= 1 listed symptom or temperature > 38.5 °C. 21-day window, 'unexplained' and anal lesions not modelled.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Leave mpox to page 40 as a cross-reference only.

judgment_calls.topic: Hot and tender groin node: bubo
judgment_calls.decision: Not encoded: 'Bubo' exists only as a morphologic abnormality, no disorder; treated as routing to page 65.
